resources.string: Workspaces group sessions independently of files. Switching or deleting a workspace keeps sessions and execution environments running.
Manage profile references and optional working directories.
Save to make this workspace permanent.
Start the selected configurations in order when opening a Workspace with no sessions. You can select more than one.
Leave empty to use the profile setting, or enter an absolute path. The original profile is preserved.
The referenced profile was removed. Edit this launch configuration.
Sessions become unassigned. Session processes, execution environments and files are preserved.
Manage folders stored independently of execution environments. Native uses host paths; Userspace Linux uses /mnt/term-shares/<name>. Changes apply to new sessions.
Connection settings provide convenience, not Android UID isolation. Native and Userspace Linux run under the same app UID.
Applies to new sessions after saving. Existing sessions keep running. AVF connections grant explicit file-copy access only.
Use 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter.
Files in this shared folder will be deleted. This is separate from deleting an environment or workspace. Finish all sessions and file operations first.
Transfers copies, without live sharing. Requires a running VM and the new file-transfer guest agent. Older images may lack support. Virtiofs mounts are unavailable.
Copy AVF file into shared folder

VM location: /home/droid/term-transfers/folder-name/relative-path. One regular file, up to 64 MiB and 2 minutes. Directories, symbolic links, path escapes and overwriting existing files are rejected. SHA-256 is verified before publication.

UUID-environment, legacy common and retained folders are listed separately. Stop the environments using this folder and finish file writes before copying. Unrelated environment sessions continue. Originals remain at their original paths, including after environment deletion. Recover interrupted Rootless storage migrations first. Import and ZIP export support regular files and directories; links or special files cause failure with originals preserved. Limit: 2 GiB and 100,000 entries. Existing workspace links block environment deletion. Use a Full environment backup to preserve their targets as well.
